body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「向量檢索找出二十份文件，reranker 把最相關的三份排到最前。這樣是否已處理資料權限與 freshness？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「reranker 會選最貼近問題的文件，所以答案會更準。」

## 排名不是准許

Retriever 的工作是從候選集合找可能有用的文件；reranker 用更細的 query-document 比較重新排序。兩者主要處理語意相關性，不會知道一份文件是否可讓這位使用者、這個租戶、這個目的和這個時間點使用。更不會知道它是否已被撤銷、被更新、超過有效期，或同一條規則已有新的 authoritative version。把它們混成一件事，常見結果是很相關但不應出現的資料被放到模型最容易引用的位置。

權限和 freshness 是候選集合的 admission rules，不是 reranker 的可選 feature。先根據 subject、role、tenant、purpose、資料分類和 source owner 取得 permitted IDs；再確認 version、effective date、retrieval timestamp 和 expiry；只有剩下的文件才進行 semantic retrieval 或 reranking。若沒有合格文件，reranker 沒有東西可以「救回來」。這時正確回應是資料不足、要求權限、或交一位 owner 判斷，而不是從更大範圍取資料。

## 找到最相關的書，不等於有權借書

圖書館員很會從架上找最切題的一本書，卻不能把鎖在別人私人櫃裡的書借給你，也不能用十年前的作息表回答今天幾點關門。排名是找書能力；借閱權和版本日期是另一道門。

## 答案在哪裡會變薄

不要一看見 retrieval quality 就加入 cross-encoder、hybrid search 和 agentic retry。先用 metadata-filtered keyword search，加上 source ID、version 和引用顯示，作為 baseline。只有在已允許而且仍有效的文件中，固定 query 仍反覆選錯，才用離線 fixture 比較 reranker 是否真正改善 decision-relevant recall，而不是只提升一個不透明分數。

## 技術判斷：把 pipeline 的順序講清楚

一個可測順序是：request contract → identity／purpose check → metadata admission → freshness check → candidate retrieval → rerank → context budget → answer and citation validation。每個 stage 都有不同失敗語義：unauthorised、source_expired、no_permitted_candidate、retrieval_miss、context_over_budget 或 citation_unresolved。不要把這些都寫成「模型沒有答到」。

測試同時要包含 relevance 與 policy。設計完全合成 fixture：一份很相似但 wrong-tenant 的文件、一份最相似但已過期的文件、一份較普通但已授權且仍有效的文件，和一個沒有任何合格來源的 case。expected result 不是「最高分」，而是 allowed candidate IDs、拒絕理由、是否需要 handoff，以及答案只可引用哪些 ID。

## 工程層面：先縮小集合，才讓模型靠近內容

將 permission filter 和 freshness filter 放在 retrieval service 或 data access layer；不要只把 metadata 放到 prompt 叫模型遵守。用 versioned source receipt 記錄候選為何被納入或排除，並使 reranker input 只包含已通過的 ID。重新索引、來源更新或 expiry 到期時，要讓 cache 和 index 有明確 invalidation／refresh 行為；否則 UI 顯示新版本，檢索卻仍交出舊 chunk，引用鏈就斷了。

可以對 reranker 做離線 eval：固定 queries、可審查的 gold allowed source、top-k、latency 和成本。它只能告訴你在那套 fixture 上的相對表現，不是對所有資料或使用者的品質保證。

## 交付、業務與風險：最相關不一定是可交付答案

資料 owner 定義 access scope 和版本 owner；產品 owner 決定「沒有可用來源」應怎樣顯示；support 或 reviewer 處理例外存取。監控包括錯誤 admission、expired-source block、no-permitted-candidate rate、citation version mismatch、人工處理時間和 reranker 對延遲／成本的影響。不要為追求 answer rate 而把 permission filter 放寬，因為看似更有用的 demo 可能只是把不該看到的內容加進 context。

## 可放進 portfolio 的 artefact

建立 rerank-after-admission-lab：

- docs/pipeline-order.md：圖示每一關的輸入、輸出、owner 和 failure state。
- fixtures/documents.json：完全合成的文件、tenant、role、purpose、version、effective date 和 expiry。
- fixtures/queries.json：固定 query 和 allowed／denied expectation。
- tests/admission-before-ranking.md：列出 candidate set、reranker input、expected citations、latency budget 和 handoff。
- evals/rerank-fixture.csv：只在已允許來源上比較 baseline 與 reranker，並保留錯誤 case。

## 延伸閱讀

[RAG：檢索、生成還是權限問題？](/zh-HK/interview-lab/rag-retrieval-generation-or-permission)、[高 similarity 不等於 relevance](/zh-HK/interview-lab/high-similarity-is-not-relevance) 和 [把不可信文件當資料處理](/zh-HK/interview-lab/treat-untrusted-documents-as-data)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。所有文件、metadata、排名和 eval 均為 synthetic draft fixture；它不是任何組織的資料架構、存取控制效果、模型 benchmark 或商業成果聲明。

Retriever 的工作是从候选集合找可能有用的文件；reranker 用更细的 query-document 比较重新排序。两者主要处理语义相关性，不知道一份文件是否允许这位用户、这个租户、这个目的和这个时间点使用，也不知道它是否已撤销、更新、超过有效期，或已有新的 authoritative version。把它们混为一谈，常见结果是很相关却不该出现的资料被放在模型最容易引用的位置。

## 答案容易在哪儿变薄

不要一看到 retrieval quality 就加入 cross-encoder、hybrid search 和 agentic retry。先用 metadata-filtered keyword search，加上 source ID、version 和引用展示，作为 baseline。只有在已允许且仍有效的文件中，固定 query 仍反复选错，才用离线 fixture 比较 reranker 是否真正改善 decision-relevant recall，而不是只让一个不透明分数变高。

## 技术判断：把 pipeline 顺序讲清楚

可测试顺序是：request contract → identity／purpose check → metadata admission → freshness check → candidate retrieval → rerank → context budget → answer and citation validation。每个 stage 有不同失败语义：unauthorised、source_expired、no_permitted_candidate、retrieval_miss、context_over_budget 或 citation_unresolved。不要把它们都写成“模型没有答到”。

将 permission filter 与 freshness filter 放在 retrieval service 或 data access layer；不要只把 metadata 放进 prompt 叫模型遵守。使用 versioned source receipt 记录候选为何纳入或排除，并让 reranker input 只包含已通过 ID。重新索引、来源更新或 expiry 到期时，cache 和 index 要有明确 invalidation／refresh 行为；否则 UI 显示新版本，检索却仍交出旧 chunk，引用链就断了。

## 交付、业务与风险：最相关不一定可交付

数据 owner 定义 access scope 与版本 owner；产品 owner 决定“没有可用来源”怎样显示；support 或 reviewer 处理例外存取。监控包括错误 admission、expired-source block、no-permitted-candidate rate、citation version mismatch、人工处理时间，以及 reranker 对延迟／成本的影响。不要为追求 answer rate 而放宽 permission filter，因为看似更有用的 demo 可能只是把不该看的内容放进 context。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “Vector retrieval returns twenty documents and a reranker puts the three most relevant documents first. Has that handled data permission and freshness?”
>
> Half-right answer: “A reranker picks the documents closest to the question, so the answer will be more accurate.”

## Ranking is not admission

A retriever finds potentially useful documents from a candidate set. A reranker compares query and document more closely to reorder those candidates. Both mainly address semantic relevance. Neither knows whether this user, tenant, purpose, and point in time may use a document. Neither knows whether it was revoked, superseded, expired, or replaced by a newer authoritative version. When those concerns are conflated, a highly relevant but ineligible document is placed exactly where the model is most likely to cite it.

Permission and freshness are admission rules for the candidate set, not optional reranker features. First obtain permitted IDs using subject, role, tenant, purpose, data class, and source-owner rules. Then verify version, effective date, retrieval timestamp, and expiry. Only the remaining documents can enter semantic retrieval or reranking. If no document qualifies, a reranker has nothing to restore. The safe response is insufficient evidence, a request for authority, or handoff to an owner—not a wider search.

## Finding the most relevant book is not permission to lend it

A librarian may be excellent at finding the most on-topic book on a shelf. They cannot lend you a book locked in someone else's private locker, and they cannot use a ten-year-old timetable to tell you today's closing time. Ranking finds books. Borrowing rights and dates are separate gates.

## Where an answer goes thin

Do not add a cross-encoder, hybrid search, and agentic retry as soon as retrieval quality is mentioned. Start with metadata-filtered keyword search, source IDs, versions, and visible citations. Only if fixed queries repeatedly choose the wrong document from the permitted, current set should you compare a reranker offline. Evaluate whether it improves decision-relevant recall, not merely an opaque score.

## Technical judgement: state the pipeline order

An inspectable order is: request contract → identity and purpose check → metadata admission → freshness check → candidate retrieval → rerank → context budget → answer and citation validation. Each stage has distinct failure semantics: unauthorised, source_expired, no_permitted_candidate, retrieval_miss, context_over_budget, or citation_unresolved. Do not collapse all of them into “the model did not answer”.

Tests must cover relevance and policy together. Create fully synthetic fixtures with a very similar wrong-tenant document, the most similar expired document, a less exciting but permitted current document, and a case with no qualifying source. The expected result is not “highest score”; it is the allowed candidate IDs, denial reason, whether handoff is needed, and the only IDs an answer may cite.

## Engineering implementation: shrink the set before bringing a model near content

Put permission and freshness filters in the retrieval service or data-access layer. Do not merely put metadata in a prompt and ask the model to obey it. Keep a versioned source receipt explaining why candidates entered or were excluded; feed the reranker only admitted IDs. Reindexing, source updates, and expiry need explicit cache and index invalidation or refresh. Otherwise the UI may show a new version while retrieval still hands out an old chunk and the citation chain has broken.

Evaluate a reranker offline with fixed queries, inspectable gold allowed sources, top-k, latency, and cost. That only describes relative behaviour on those fixtures; it is not a quality guarantee for every source or user.

## Delivery, business, and risk

A data owner defines access scope and version ownership. A product owner defines how “no usable source” appears. Support or review handles exceptional access. Monitor incorrect admission, expired-source blocks, no-permitted-candidate rate, citation-version mismatch, human handling time, and the reranker's latency and cost impact. Do not relax a permission filter to chase answer rate. A more helpful-looking demo may simply have added material that should not enter the context.

## A portfolio artefact someone can inspect

Build rerank-after-admission-lab with:

- docs/pipeline-order.md: each stage's input, output, owner, and failure state.
- fixtures/documents.json: fully synthetic documents, tenants, roles, purposes, versions, effective dates, and expiry.
- fixtures/queries.json: fixed queries with allowed and denied expectations.
- tests/admission-before-ranking.md: candidate set, reranker input, expected citations, latency budget, and handoff.
- evals/rerank-fixture.csv: compare baseline and reranker only over permitted sources and retain the failure cases.

## Further reading

[RAG: a retrieval, generation, or permission problem?](/en/interview-lab/rag-retrieval-generation-or-permission), [high similarity is not relevance](/en/interview-lab/high-similarity-is-not-relevance), and [treat untrusted documents as data](/en/interview-lab/treat-untrusted-documents-as-data).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. All documents, metadata, rankings, and evals are synthetic draft fixtures. It is not a statement about an organisation's data architecture, access-control efficacy, model benchmark, or business result.
